properties.headline: Freeze Watch issued November 23 at 9:55AM MST until November 25 at 8:00AM MST by NWS Midland/Odessa TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 29 possible.

* WHERE...Portions of southeast New Mexico and southwest and western
Texas.

* WHEN...From Tuesday evening through Wednesday morning.

* IMPACTS...Late season cold snaps have the potential to damage or
kill young vegetation.
properties.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

Bring pets indoors, or ensure that they have warm, dry shelter.
